prototype_feel_reasons: Mobile’s right-edge fade is somewhat heavy and washes out the partially visible secondary activity.
The large empty area below the scene makes the overall screen composition feel less finished, although the image asset itself is well integrated.
The desktop hotspot indicator over the upper-right trees is very faint and can resemble an unintended translucent artifact.
issues: mobile/main river scene — the right-side worker and judging board are partially cropped and heavily faded; acceptable for a horizontal scroller, but the fade obscures the preview of additional content — narrow/soften the edge-fade mask and retain more contrast at the scroll boundary

desktop/main river scene — the translucent hotspot over the upper-right trees has weak definition and reads like a pale blemish — increase border/icon contrast or use the same clearly framed marker treatment as the active pencil hotspot
screen/lower composition — excessive blank green space makes the otherwise polished scene presentation feel unfinished — reduce the minimum-height or add a deliberate continuation/navigation element
